## Context / Problem
Three `tests/external/live_jira_cloud_mutation` files contain three audited module-docstring blocks. Their blobs and contracts were revalidated against immutable leaf base `665d1d0480187380f82e59bd95af1f0c44274732`. This base includes the canonical reconciler-engine import-path refactor in `_cloud_mutation_support.py`; the documentation edit must preserve that executable state.

## Approach and identity
Condense only allowlisted ordinary comments and true leading docstrings. Preserve all runtime strings, prompts, fixtures, decorators, assertions, subprocess arguments, and executable behavior. Stable block IDs are `path::module-docstring`, `path::<qualified-symbol>-docstring`, or `path::<qualified-symbol>::comment(<opening words>)`; use `<module>` as the owner for module-level comments. The line spans below are immutable base citations, never the identity anchor. Adjacent blank-line cleanup is allowed only when attached to an edited block.

For each declared path, compare the immutable `665d1d0480187380f82e59bd95af1f0c44274732:<path>` blob directly with the final leaf commit, even if the implementation branch is based on a later main. Parse with `type_comments=True`; remove only allowlisted leading docstrings from `ast.Module`, `ast.ClassDef`, `ast.FunctionDef`, and `ast.AsyncFunctionDef` by their qualified-owner anchors; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; and require the remaining AST to match. This preserves runtime strings and every executable expression. Tokenize comments and compare every matched directive-bearing physical line plus any shebang byte-for-byte. The exact leaf changed-path set (`HEAD^..HEAD`) must equal the first-class `file_impact` set.

## Scope — immutable base citations
- `_cloud_mutation_support.py:1-21` — preserve bounded blast radius, run-unique labels, primary deletion, and sweep backstops.
- `conftest.py:1-9` — preserve explicit canary enrollment, client ownership, and cleanup role.
- `test_cloud_coordinator_lifecycle.py:1-20` — preserve the public-facade boundary, one-plan scope, live-write safety, and teardown guarantees.

Consumers are pytest fixture discovery; the lifecycle module imports the support helper; `.github/workflows/external-integration.yml` and the directory README invoke the live suite; and `tests/unit/test_external_integration_cloud_mutation_workflow.py` pins the workflow lane. No target-specific runtime docstring reader was found. Preserve `_cloud_mutation_support.py` `noqa: BLE001` directives at pinned lines 145/154 and lifecycle `noqa: E402` directives at 35-38/43 byte-for-byte; preserve exact shebang absence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The leaf commit changes exactly the declared `file_impact` paths and only allowlisted prose blocks or their adjacent blank lines; the immutable-base normalized-AST/runtime/directive/shebang guard passes.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and retains its listed contract and real consumers; repetition, chronology, obvious narration, and ornament are removed rather than moved.
- [ ] A reviewer who did not author the edits posts a leaf-linked TSV with one row per edited block: stable block ID, immutable-before citation, final-commit citation (or `DELETED` plus surviving neighbor), preserved contract/consumer, `directives_exact`, before/after words, reviewer session, `semantic-preservation`, and `bloat-removal`.
- [ ] Every TSV row records `directives_exact=PASS`, `semantic-preservation=PASS`, and `bloat-removal=PASS`; missing rows, duplicate IDs, bad citations, or any non-PASS result block closure.
- [ ] The focused hermetic checks, `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv lint/typecheck checks all pass. Collection-only checks never execute live Jira mutations; the full suite is delegated to Gerrit CI for this documentation-only leaf.

## Verification
The authoritative executable commands and DD intent are recorded in first-class `verify_commands`. Run the scoped lint/typecheck and focused checks locally; Gerrit CI owns full-suite verification for this documentation-only leaf.

Live Jira tests are collection-only here. The five offline workflow nodes execute normally; neither live lifecycle node may execute as part of this ticket's focused verification.
